title: Charge Air Pressure Sensor High Error
detail_of_failure: High voltage is sensed in the pressure signal circuit of the charge (boost) pressure and temperature sensor.
controller_action: Operates with charge pressure as fixed value.
related_information: • Input voltage from the charge air pressure sensor (boost pressure sensor) can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 36501 (V)) • Boost pressure by charge air pressure sensor (boost pressure sensor) can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 36500 (kPa)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position. • If the sensor connector is removed, the failure code [CA123] is shown even in the normal state.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
If failure code [CA227] is also shown at the same time, do the troubleshooting for that code first.

steps.cause: Defective boost pressure and temperature sensor
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector BOOST PRESS IMT. 3. Starting switch: ON If the failure code changes from [CA122] to [CA123], the boost pressure sensor is defective. REMARK Failure code [CA153] for the temperature sensor is shown at the same time. This is because the sensor connector is disconnected, and you can ignore it. Reference 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Starting switch: ON
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and BOOST PRESS & IMT, and connect a T-adapter to the female side of ECM.

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector BOOST PRESS & IMT, and insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Turn the starting switch to ON position (with connector BOOST PRESS & IMT disconnected).
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
